name: FMHawks OH 2025
information: This competition does not have 3x3. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited. You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbCtGIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ac240e88f022b6787f4ef5a57bb7e03ecac60e98/Cubing%20Frontiers%20LLC%20Banner%20Transparent.png)
